The D96-TCE Albatross, formally known as the Dropship 96 - Troop Carrier, Equipment, is a heavy-lift dropship used by the United Nations Space Command. It was developed and produced by Ushuaia Armory.

The Dropship 81-Long Range Transport, abbreviated D81-LRT, or more commonly known as the Condor is an older, medium-sized transport craft capable of slipspace travel. It is used by the Sedran Colonial Guard for space travel since they cannot afford larger, more up-to-date cruisers and ships. It has two decks.

The D82-EST Darter is a dropship used by the United Nations Space Command to deliver supplies, such as rations and munitions, to forward bases. It is very similar in form and function to the D96-TCE Albatross, though it is larger than the latter.
The DDS-class carrier is a heavy warship classification within the Covenant Navy. It is 3,000 meters long and is armed with Pulse laser turrets and two Plasma Torpedoes.
